en.name: Mahabhulekh (7/12 & 8A Land Records)
en.description: Maharashtra land record portal to view and download 7/12 (Satbara) and 8A extracts online.
en.eligibility: Landowners / general public for non-certified view; certified copies per process.
en.benefits: Instant access to land ownership, tenure, and mutation status; supports loans and transactions.
